Instruments.spectrum_analyzer_signal_hound.System Class¶

class Instruments.spectrum_analyzer_signal_hound.System(instrument, data_handler)[source]¶

Bases: object

The System commands are used to perform system level software actions and query information about the system.

__init__(instrument, data_handler)[source]¶
close()[source]¶

CLOSe - Disconnect any active device and close the Spike software.

This command disconnects any active device and closes the Spike software. It also terminates the socket connection with the Spike software. Note: There is not a way to reopen the software using SCPI commands.

Parameter:

None

Return:

None

is_preset()[source]¶

PRESet? - Query if the active device is preset.

This command closes and reopens the active device. The process can take between 6-20 seconds depending on the device type. Returns 1 for success, 0 otherwise.

Parameter:

None

Return:

bool: True if system is preset, False otherwise.

PRESet:USER:LOAD - Load a user preset from the given file name.
